## Method overview

| Field | Entry |
|---|---|
| **Family / class** | Empirical indicators → Risk-based triage |
| **Method name** | Productivity–susceptibility analysis (PSA) |
| **Short description** | Productivity–susceptibility analysis: scores productivity (life history) and susceptibility (exposure to the fishery) to rank the relative vulnerability of stocks. |
| **Main outputs** | Relative vulnerability score by stock for prioritisation |
| **Typical use case** | Life history and fishery exposure, no time series needed |

::: {.callout-tip}
